authoring.author: claude-sonnet-5.5 (marnix-faces lane), same design as marnix-124-138 (strip checked)

notes: 1876-78 municipal row (B. de Greef): flat bracketed cornice, 3 window axes x 4 storeys, central door, narrow stepped crown over the middle axis (approximated by a pediment cap), pilaster strips at the party walls (not modelled).

groundFloor.note: Residential: house door in the middle axis, 2 windows (strip.jpg).

rhythm.bays: 3 window axes over a central door axis; pilaster strips at both party walls
rhythm.identicalBays: all 3 axes identical on storeys 1-3; ground floor: 2 windows + central door
rhythm.symmetry: mirror-symmetric about the middle axis (door, gable)
rhythm.groundFloor: green door with stone surround and side lights, 2 windows
rhythm.roofline: flat bracketed cornice; narrow stepped (trap) gable with finial over the middle axis, one attic window
schemaLimits: stepped gable with finial is a pediment cap
pilaster strips, drainpipes, brick bands and stone lintel detail not modelled
